summary: DiamondRock Hospitality filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing completion of its acquisition of The Bellmoor Inn & Spa, a 79-room hotel in Rehoboth Beach, Delaware, for $31.0 million in cash. The deal closed October 1, 2026, and was announced via press release furnished under Regulation FD. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or earnings contribution was disclosed. The transaction expands DiamondRock's leisure/resort portfolio, funded presumably from balance sheet capacity or its credit facility. Watch for updated 2026 guidance, cap-rate commentary, and any follow-on dispositions under the REIT's capital-recycling strategy.
